description: Get complete detail for a single LinkedIn campaign, including the full targetingCriteria object (all included/excluded facets), bid strategy, unit cost, daily/total budget, run schedule, objective, optimization target, format, and locale. Use this when you need to audit targeting setup, diagnose budget configuration, or confirm campaign structure before pulling performance data.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account numeric ID or URN. Defaults to LINKEDIN_DEFAULT_AD_ACCOUNT.

campaign_id.description: Campaign numeric ID or URN (urn:li:sponsoredCampaign:123). Required.
